scientific_integrity: The conditional-regression and covariance identities have an analytic all-size proof. A standalone exact-rational checker reproduces finite small-size examples. Historical originality cannot be guaranteed from the accessible literature; independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The proof covers only independent uniform observations with fully specified parameters; the conditional mean does not imply stochastic order or a conditional law. The full 1996 exact-distribution article was not accessible for a conclusive historical-priority comparison.
title: A sharp U-shaped range regression for the Cramér–von Mises statistic
